title: External Customer / Agent Communication & Notification Delivery
businessRequirement: Deliver approved operational communications to CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE and authorized AGENT portal users without exposing internal operations, SLA, control-tower, finance, carrier-confidential or KYC data.
objective: Create one governed external communication layer over the frozen CR-005 internal Notification Center and existing portal booking scopes, supporting in-app delivery, provider-ready email delivery state, retry/resend, templates, preferences, acknowledgements and audit history.

web: Customer/shipper/consignee portal Communication Center embedded into existing customer portal
Internal external-message composer/history entry point without redesigning frozen navigation
api: Template rendering and external visibility policy
In-app delivery plus provider-ready email delivery state/retry

privacyMatrix.CUSTOMER: Only communications for bookings inside customerId scope.
privacyMatrix.SHIPPER: Only communications for bookings inside partyId shipper scope.
privacyMatrix.CONSIGNEE: Only communications for bookings inside partyId consignee scope.
privacyMatrix.AGENT: Only communications for agent-scoped bookings; forwarding messages require existing FORWARDING_DIRECT_COLOAD_CROSS_TRADE permission where applicable.
privacyMatrix.GLOBAL_ADMIN: May compose approved external communications for any scoped booking.
privacyMatrix.CONTROL_TOWER: May compose approved operational external communications; no finance-confidential payload.
privacyMatrix.BRANCH_OPS: May compose only for branch-scoped bookings.
privacyMatrix.FINANCE: May compose only approved PAYMENT_REQUEST / RELEASE_REQUEST / INVOICE_NOTICE categories; external message contains sanitized customer-safe fields only.

delivery.emailPolicy: If no approved provider endpoint is configured, record PENDING_CONFIGURATION and never mark SENT.
delivery.resendRetry: Explicit internal retry/resend creates deterministic delivery-attempt evidence; duplicate idempotency keys do not duplicate logical messages.

acceptanceCriteria: CR-005 internal Notification Center remains internal-only and unchanged in semantics.
External users see only customer-safe communications for bookings inside existing bookingScope.
Internal notes, SLA/control-tower metadata, internal finance detail, carrier-confidential data and KYC are never returned by external communication endpoints.
Messages support read and required acknowledgement without mutating booking/document/payment/release lifecycle state.
In-app delivery is durable and auditable.
Email delivery is provider-ready; absent provider configuration remains PENDING_CONFIGURATION rather than false SENT.
Retry/resend and idempotency do not create duplicate logical messages.
GLOBAL_ADMIN, CONTROL_TOWER, BRANCH_OPS and FINANCE publish rights follow category and booking scope policy.
CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE and AGENT cannot use internal publish/history administration endpoints.
Full Web/API/shared regression passes with no database migration.
